theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: As the highest-ranked eligible theme with a confirmed uptrend (gate passed, hurst=trend) and durability above 0.6, it sits at the intersection of trend discipline and leadership focus. Overweight because the trend gate's risk-control edge supports staying with the eligible leader.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The theme is ineligible (gate fail), has middling durability (0.41), and ranks in the lower half of momentum. Given the validated risk-control edge of the absolute-trend gate, underweight is a trend-disciplined risk-avoidance posture, not an alpha-seeking short. Scorable via 3033.HK provides clarity.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK outperforms the Hang Seng by 5% over any consecutive 10 trading days.
